description: This PHP source file defines the 'Setting' class within the Opencart admin model, responsible for managing store settings including retrieval, editing, and deletion from the database.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Represents the settings management model in the Opencart admin module, providing methods to retrieve, update, and delete store configuration settings.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a specific store ID, returning an array of setting records.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Fetches a specific setting by code and store ID, returning an associative array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Updates or inserts multiple settings for a specific store and code, overwriting previous settings.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes settings associated with a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Deletes all settings with a specific code across all stores.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all settings for a particular store ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single setting value by key and store ID, decoding JSON if serialized.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Updates a specific setting's value and serialization flag for a given code, key, and store ID.
